d: In this episode of Talking Politics, The Hindu's Political Editor Nistula Hebbar goes behind the scenes of Uttar Pradesh politics ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Following the central government's assurance to the Supreme Court that a committee will review the stayed 2026 UGC social equity regulations, Hebbar analyzes how campus equity rules have intersected with general-category and Brahmin voter sentiment in UP. The episode breaks down the shifting electoral math since the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, including Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's PDA (Pichhda, Dalit, Alpsankhyak)…
